# Applied to every pip install in CI through PIP_CONSTRAINT.
# certifi < 2026.10.19 and pip < 26.2.2 (vendored certifi) trust the compromised
# eMudhra/emSign CAs, see
# https://discuss.python.org/t/information-for-python-users-regarding-emudhra-emsign-ca-certificate-security-incident/109576
certifi >= 2026.10.19
pip >= 26.2.2
